chunks: The esteemed jurist Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Isfahani, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Makhul ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad al-Yashkuri narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah, from Salman al-Farisi (may Allah be pleased with him). He said:

I asked the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family): Who is your successor from your Nation, for no prophet was ever sent without having a successor from his nation? The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: It has not yet been revealed to me. So I waited as long as Allah willed. Then I entered the mosque, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) called me and said: O Salman, you asked me about my successor from my Nation. Do you know who was the successor of Moses from his nation? I said: His successor was Joshua son of Nun, his attendant. He said: Do you know why he bequeathed to him? I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said: He bequeathed to him because he was the most knowledgeable of his nation after him. And my successor, the most knowledgeable of my Nation after me, is Ali ibn Abi Talib.

key_terms.أعلم أمتي من بعدي: 'The most knowledgeable of my Nation after me' -- the criterion for prophetic succession
key_terms.وصي: Successor/deputy (wasi) -- one designated to carry on a prophet's mission after him
key_terms.يوشع بن نون: Joshua son of Nun -- the successor of Prophet Moses

ai.seo_question: Who did Prophet Muhammad designate as his successor and the most knowledgeable of his Nation after him?
ai.summary: Salman al-Farisi asked the Prophet Muhammad (s) who would be his successor from his Nation, since every prophet had a successor. Initially the Prophet said it had not yet been revealed to him. Later, in the mosque, the Prophet called Salman and asked if he knew who was the successor of Moses. Salman replied it was Joshua son of Nun. The Prophet explained that Moses chose Joshua because he was the most knowledgeable of his people after him, and declared: 'My successor, the most knowledgeable of my Nation after me, is Ali ibn Abi Talib.'

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Makhul b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Rahman b. al-Aswad al-Yashkiri narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Ubadullah from Salman al-Farisi (ra). He said:

I asked the Messenger of Allah (s): Who is your deputy from your Nation, for no prophet is raised except that he has a deputy from his Nation? So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: It has yet to be revealed to me. So, I remained for as long as Allah willed for me to remain; then I entered the mosque, and the Messenger of Allah (s) called me and said: O Salman! You asked me about the deputy of my Nation – do you know who the deputy of Musa from his Nation was? So, I said: His deputy was a young man, Yusha` b. Nun. He said: Do you know why he was appointed? I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said: He deputed him because he was the most knowledge person in his Nation after him.  My deputy is the most knowledgeable person from my Nation after me –  `Ali b. Abi Talib.
